title: Exotic Floral Saudi Arabian Dates Tagine
description: A crumbly and flavorful Saudi Arabian dish featuring dry sherry and lacquer-glaze, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this tagine is shojin-friendly and showcases the beauty of floral and dry ingredients in harmony.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix the dates, dry sherry, lacquer glaze, rose water, and orange blossom water in a bowl.
Add the almond flour, coconut oil, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix until crumbly.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the tagine warm, garnished with fresh flowers if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Reheat the tagine in the oven or on the stovetop before serving.
